facts.fact: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to fund a feasibility study for a jointly government-owned regional communications satellite, with partner-state contributions due by 30 September 2026; the roadmap and budget were approved, but only the study is funded and no satellite build is stated; the account-opening is dated to the report's 2026-08-24 publication.
